headline: Pension obligations update, plus reports from municipal boards and commissions and ex-officio members.
summary: Pension obligations is the main topic, with a report from an invited guest from a municipal board or commission. The agenda also lists an executive session, if the town attorney recommends one.
items: Reports from ex-officio members: the Mayor's representative, the Board of Education representative, and the Legislative Council budget committee chair or designee
Finance Commission chair update on pension obligations
Update report from municipal boards and commissions, with an invited guest
Executive session, if recommended by the town attorney
location: Hamden Government Center, First Floor Conference Room (hybrid, also on Zoom)
